NEUROTH

Wir suchen Verstärkung!

"Besser hören, besser leben" - dieser Philosophie hat sich Neuroth bereits seit über 115 Jahren verschrieben. 
Vom traditionsreichen Familienbetrieb hat sich Neuro... 1 Business Development Sales (m/w/d) Business Development Sales (f/m/d) 

You have big ambitions. We offer outstanding opportunities. 

Help shape the future of our international retail network: You identify new business opportunities, develop sustainable growth strategies, and drive their successful implementation across our international markets. Working closely with our country organizations and central corporate functions, you will lead strategic transformation and integration initiatives, making a significant contribution to Neuroth's continued development and long-term success. 

Our team is looking for a motivated and entrepreneurial professional to join us as Business Development Sales (f/m/d) in Graz, helping to identify and realize growth opportunities across our international organization.  

Your Responsibilities 

 * Identify and develop new business opportunities within our international retail network and translate them into concrete growth initiatives. 
 * Analyze market trends, competitive developments, and customer needs to develop effective sales and market expansion strategies. 
 * Initiate, manage, and support strategic business initiatives that drive the further development of our international organization. 
 * Collaborate closely with management teams across our country organizations and relevant corporate functions. 
 * Support country organizations in addressing complex challenges, change processes, post-merger integrations, and transformation projects. 
 * Facilitate the exchange of best practices across markets and support the sustainable implementation and scaling of successful business models. 
 * Monitor the effectiveness of implemented initiatives and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 

 What You Bring 

 * A degree in Business Administration, Management, Sales, or a comparable field. 
 * Several years of professional experience in Business Development, Corporate Development, Consulting, or Retail Management. 
 * Proven experience in developing and implementing strategic growth initiatives in an international environment. 
 * Strong executer with can-do mentality and a proactive mindset, strong execution skills and enthusiasm for driving change. 
 * Strong analytical skills combined with a structured and solution-oriented approach. 
 * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across different organizational levels. 
 * An entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution capabilities, and a passion for driving change. 
 * Excellent German and good English language skills. 
 * Willingness to travel internationally. 

What We Offer 

 * A strategically important role with significant impact and a high degree of autonomy in a successful international company. 
 * The opportunity to actively shape Neuroth's future growth and development. 
 * Close collaboration with international leaders and key decision-makers. 
 * A dynamic and appreciative working environment with short decision-making processes. 
 * Attractive professional development and career opportunities. 
 * Flexible working hours and home-office options. 
 * A wide range of social benefits and employee perks. 

For this position, the annual gross salary starts at EUR 4.600. Depending on your qualifications and professional experience, we are prepared to offer a higher salary. 

Do you think entrepreneurially, recognize opportunities, and want to actively drive sustainable growth? Are you interested in new technologies and future-oriented projects in the field of chip design?

Then Photeon is the right choice!

As one of the market leaders for turnkey solutions for our broad portfolio of customers, Photeon offers possibility to work on many interesting and highly complex products for Automotive, Industrial, Medical and many other markets. We offer a dynamic, exciting, and friendly environment, as well as many possibilities for your further development in the direction that suits you the best. 

We invite you to be a part of our family and be a driver of developing your knowledge, skills, and experience. 1 Staff Analog Design Engineer (m/w/d) Your Role:

· Design of high performance analog circuits (e.g. linear regulators, switching

converters, DAC`s, ADC's, bandgaps, high speed PHYs)

· Understand technical requirements and electrical specifications of analog circuits

· Define verification and validation methods used to ensure spec compliance

· Responsible of the technical quality and on-schedule delivery

· Create high quality documentation

· Interface with other functional teams (layout, digital, test, quality)

· Ability to work closely with other members of the design team and with the other

functions of the wider product development team

· Creating and supporting innovative ideas in his/her field of knowledge

collaboratively

· Measurable impact on working results within organizational area

· Gives technical guidance

· Demonstrates active knowledge transfer and best practice sharing

Your Profile:

· Bachelor or Master degree or equivalent in electrical engineering physics or similar

· Knowledge of semiconductor physics and semiconductor technologies

· Several years of professional experience in the industry (minimum +7 years)

· Experience with designing analog circuits

· Team Player

· Ability to work autonomously

· Good verbal and written English skills, German is an advantage

· Has proven ability to solve complex problems

What We Offer:

· Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and a talented team.

· Personal development and individual training plans.

· Innovative products and business environment.

· Flexible working hours.

· Friendly and supportive environment.

· Exciting, varied work in a growing and internationally active company.

· Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing support.

· Modern office spaces.

· Team building events.

· Competitive compensation well above the relevant collective agreement and

depends on qualification and experience.The minimum monthly gross remuneration

according to collective agreement is EUR 3.954,00 in "ST1, Einstiegsstufe" and EUR

4.611 "ST2, Regelstufe" and will be adjusted according to qualification and experience.

At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.

Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.

Because at Lam, we believe that when people are the priority and they re inspired to unleash the power of innovation for a better world together, anything is possible. 1 Process Engineer (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500

REQ ID: 200982

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 * Responsible for performing professional process engineering research, development and evaluation in semiconductor environment

 * Reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication and evaluation of products including in-house lab demonstrations

 * Conceives and plans projects involving definition and selection of new concepts and approaches

 * Works with customer and senior engineers cross functionally to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements and business issues/ challenges.

 * Acts as customer technology manager in the planning, data collection, analysis and reporting

 * Acts as single point of contact accountable for process related customer requests

 * Drives introduction and evaluation of new technologies at customer sites including new tool qualification

Other Job Responsibilities

 * Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements

 * Works with cross-functional teams to get information and results needed

 * Flexibility to travel to meet business requirements

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 * MSc in in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or Physics with with no previous professional experience; or equivalent experience preferably in the field of wet clean/advanced packaging 

 * Familiarity with working in a chemical laboratory, having experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques

 * In-depth understanding and experience in Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Design of Experiments (DOE)

 * Excellent social skills with ability to work within diverse teams

 * Creative thinking and strong problem-solving capabilities, able to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment with competing priorities

 * Excellent oral and written communication skills and presentation skills in English

WHAT WE ARE OFFERING

This position is subject to the Austrian Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) for Employees in the Metal Technology Industry in the occupation group F depending on educational background. A higher payment is negotiable depending on education, expertise and skills. The monthly salary is paid 14 times per year. 

WORKING HOURS

Flexitime model 38,5 hours/week, Core hours (Mo-Th 9-15, Fr 9-11:30)

APPLICATION:

 * Familiarization with refinery/petchem processes and their process engineering settings and modes of operation as well as the process control systems.

What we are looking for
